description: ETP/v1 (efficient trace payload) sent by tracers to /v1.0/traces. It describes the payload as deserialized by deserialize_v1_trace (utils/proxy/traces/trace_v1.py): msgpack integer keys are replaced by their name, string references are resolved against the payload string table, attribute lists are flattened into objects, and trace ids are hex encoded

strings.description: String table, when the tracer sends it explicitly. Streamed payloads inline strings on first use, and the deserializer rebuilds the table

container_id.description: Container id, as reported by the tracer

chunks.description: Trace chunks: spans of a single trace sharing the same sampling decision

sampling_mechanism.description: Mechanism that made the sampling decision (SamplingMechanism)

dropped_trace.description: True when the chunk was dropped by the tracer sampler, and is only sent for stats computation

env.description: v1 promotes env out of the attributes into a span field

version.description: v1 promotes version out of the attributes into a span field

component.description: v1 promotes the integration name out of the attributes into a span field

error.description: v1 carries the error flag as a boolean, and not as an integer like v0.4 and v0.5

span_kind.description: Span kind (SpanKind), as an integer and not as a string like v0.4 and v0.5

trace_state.description: W3C tracestate, either inlined or as an index in the string table. In the latter case, the deserializer adds the resolved value in tracestate

tracestate.description: Resolved trace_state, added by the deserializer

flags.description: W3C trace flags, with the bit 31 set when they are known

attributes.description: Attribute map. v1 carries meta and metrics of a span in a single attributes object, and the payload and each chunk have their own attributes, shared by the spans below them. Each AnyValue has been reduced by the deserializer to a string, a boolean, a number, an array or an object, and attributes carrying serialized JSON (_dd.appsec.json, _dd.appsec.s.*, ...) are deserialized as well

_dd.top_level.description: 1 on top level spans, and absent otherwise

trace-id.description: 128 bits trace id. Tracers send 16 raw bytes, that the deserializer hex encodes and prefixes with 0x
